title.rendered: Arqaam team excels at the Bloomberg Square Mile Relay Run 2024

content.rendered:
Proud to see our Arqaam team excel at the Bloomberg Square Mile Relay Run 2024! A huge shoutout to all DUBAI runners for unlocking a $30,000 donation to UAE Food Bank.

This contribution will empower 10,000 marginalized youths through food care packages.

View More
